import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Load the data
data = """survived,pclass,sex,age,sibsp,parch,fare,embarked,class,who,adult_male,deck,embark_town,alive,alone
0,3,male,22.0,1,0,7.25,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,False
1,1,female,38.0,1,0,71.2833,C,First,woman,False,C,Cherbourg,yes,False
1,3,female,26.0,0,0,7.925,S,Third,woman,False,,Southampton,yes,True
1,1,female,35.0,1,0,53.1,S,First,woman,False,C,Southampton,yes,False
0,3,male,35.0,0,0,8.05,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,True"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Dataset Visualization', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 1: Survival by Sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_sex = df.groupby(['sex', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
survival_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax1.set_title('Survival by Sex')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sex')
ax1.set_ylabel('Count')
ax1.legend(['Did not survive', 'Survived'], loc='upper right')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# Plot 2: Survival by Class
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survival_class = df.groupby(['class', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
survival_class.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax2.set_title('Survival by Passenger Class')
ax2.set_xlabel('Class')
ax2.set_ylabel('Count')
ax2.legend(['Did not survive', 'Survived'], loc='upper right')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# Plot 3: Age distribution by survival
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
colors = ['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71']
for i, surv in enumerate([0, 1]):
    subset = df[df['survived'] == surv]['age'].dropna()
    if len(subset) > 0:
        ax3.hist(subset, bins=10, alpha=0.7, label=f'{"Survived" if surv else "Did not survive"}', color=colors[i])
ax3.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age')
ax3.set_ylabel('Count')
ax3.legend()

# Plot 4: Fare vs Age colored by survival
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
scatter = ax4.scatter(df['age'], df['fare'], c=df['survived'], cmap='RdYlGn', 
                      s=100, edgecolors='black', alpha=0.7)
ax4.set_title('Fare vs Age (colored by Survival)')
ax4.set_xlabel('Age')
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax4)
cbar.set_ticks([0, 1])
cbar.set_ticklabels(['Did not survive', 'Survived'])

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
